programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Day 1 welcomes you to Desire Mapping—an approach to living guided by how you want to feel, not just what you want to do. By shifting from goal lists to heart-centered intention, this introduction invites you to honor presence, intuition, and the feelings that shape a fulfilling life.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Desire Mapping guides you to live from the heart, focusing on how you want to feel rather than just what you want to do. Through practices like Soul Limber, appreciation, attention management, Core Desired Feelings, and exploring your inner selves, you gain clarity, agency, joy, and purpose in creating a fulfilling life.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Set down your Core Desired Feelings and explore the words that shape your inner world. This practice reveals patterns, clarifies your choices, and turns intention into living energy. Your feelings and words become a beacon, guiding you to live from the heart with focus and purpose.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.sub-title: The Desire Map Course Part 2 and 3
programme.desc: Step into Intentional Creation using your Core Desired Feelings as your guide. Align actions with heart-centered intentions, release what no longer serves you, and transform your goals into sacred desires. Cultivate agency, joy, and flow as your inner world shapes your outer reality.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Integrate your Core Desired Feelings through daily practice, reflection, and heart-centered rituals. Using mindfulness, breath, and prayer, cultivate sacred connection, peace, and purpose. Return to your heart each day, and let your love and clarity ripple into the world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show - Power of Healing
programme.desc: Join Lisa Garr as she speaks with millennial Author, Speaker, & Inspirational Entertainer Justin Michael Williams about the true power of healing. Justin discusses creating a future of inclusion and diversity while using music and meditation to spread his message of waking up the world! Info: justinmichaelwilliams.com.

programme.title: The Aware Show

Arylo discusses setting boundaries and allowing ourselves space to breathe by finding ways in which we can receive support. Info: christinearylo.com.

programme.title: The Aware Show

programme.desc: Today Lisa Garr discusses the power of intentions with best-selling author and international speaker Lynne McTaggart. Info: lynnemctaggart.com.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Human Nature vs. Modern Culture
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Approaching Trauma with Curiosity and Compassion
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - The Connection Between Health and Childhood Trauma
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Mom Didn't Fight for Me
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: I Don't Trust I'll Find Someone to Create a Life With
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships and Your Spiritual Journey
programme.desc: Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: How to Have Miraculous Relationships
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships Are Opportunities for Growth
programme.desc: The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Daniela Castaño, de 19 años, fue brutalmente asesinada en La Estrella, Antioquia, en enero de 2020. Su asesina, Valentina García, recibió solo 10 años de cárcel tras un polémico preacuerdo con la Fiscalía, lo que indignó a su familia y expertos legales.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los ataques de perros peligrosos a niños aumentan en Colombia. Aunque existen leyes, muchos dueños siguen sin responsabilizarse. Las víctimas enfrentan lesiones graves, y las autoridades luchan contra la impunidad, mientras los ataques continúan.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los piques ilegales siguen causando muertes y accidentes graves, dejando víctimas inocentes. A pesar de no estar tipificados como delito, aumentan la inseguridad, lo que genera demandas por leyes más estrictas para frenar esta práctica peligrosa.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Sueños de éxito transformados en pesadillas. Inversiones millonarias en franquicias prometedoras que se desmoronan bajo la corrupción y las mentiras. Desde jardines infantiles hasta centros de estética, historias de fraude y desesperación emergen.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ha habido un aumento en los ataques contra la policía y los delincuentes muestran menos miedo a la autoridad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.sub-title: La niña de los sueños rotos
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Leidy Johana García tuvo una hija con José Luis Mota, su primer novio, pero la relación terminó por problemas económicos. José Luis, incapaz de aceptar la separación de su hija, asesinó a golpes a Leidy en un ataque de ira. Fue capturado por la comunidad al intentar huir. Tras dos años y medio de juicio, fue condenado por homicidio simple a una pena mínima excarcelable y quedó en libertad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Julio Hermes formó una familia en Venadillo. Su hijo Jhon Andrés fue acusado de tener una relación incestuosa con su media hermana Angie Tatiana, quien quedó embarazada. En 2008, Angie desapareció y fue hallada muerta.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.sub-title: La Tinta Se Sirve mejor Fría
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Helmuth Ángulo lleva 21 años buscando a sus padres, Gerardo Ángulo y Carmenza Castañeda, secuestrados por el Bloque Oriental de las FARC el 19 de abril de 2000 en la vía La Calera, Cundinamarca. Con 68 años cada uno, seis hijos y dieciocho nietos, la pareja nunca alcanzó a celebrar sus bodas de oro. Su calvario ha marcado media vida de dolor e incertidumbre para la familia.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Miguel Rodríguez Moreno, hijo del excapo del Cartel de Cali Miguel Rodríguez Orejuela, escribe un libro sobre los 16 años que su padre y su tío Gilberto llevan presos en EE.UU. Ambos, ya ancianos, cumplen 30 años de condena por narcotráfico tras controlar el 80% de la cocaína exportada de Colombia. Sus familias buscan una sentencia anticipada por su delicada salud, antes de su liberación en 2029.

Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 208
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. DCI Barnaby begins his investigations when it is found that one skeleton had modern dental work. Meanwhile, DS Troy, having been promoted to Inspector has his last case in Midsomer, to look into the murder of a youth, Simon Mayfield (Henry Cavill), who had caused problems for many in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. He is instantly involved in his first case, a woman stabbed after attending a Spanish-themed evening in Midsomer Mallow. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. It quickly becomes clear that the two victims knew a secret about one of the villagers. Are both crimes connected?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Parva have all come out one evening to see the revival of an old Pagan festival. The centrepiece is a straw effigy of a woman. When it is set alight and people look on in wonder, it soon turns to horror when the local curate screams out in pain from within the effigy. The villagers quickly turn against Liz Francis, a local teacher who had organised the event.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years after Ferdy Villiers committed suicide at the family home of Draycott Hall, the extended Villiers family gather together to celebrate Christmas. When a riddle in a Christmas cracker proclaims that two members of the family will be dead by midnight on Boxing Day, everyone takes no notice, until elderly Aunt Lydia nearly dies after getting locked in the garage, after her car has restarted itself and then later in the night, falls down the stairs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield at Cooper's Cross is where Simon Bright's vintage car is found by Frances Kirby. Inside she finds Simon dead, as the evening before his death had been on a romantic date with his girlfriend Laura Sharp. Laura is nowhere to be found, both Barnaby and Jones, newly promoted to DS, need to work out if it was a suicide pact gone wrong or whether it was murder and track down Laura.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters. She receives a real shock, when she discovers that Rex's friends had been told she had died in a plane crash. Things become complicated when Rex's body is found in the nearby river. Barnaby and Jones quickly turn up trying to workout who would wish Rex harm. Several friends of Rex come forward with multiple 'new' wills each being sole beneficiary.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst on a business trip to China, Alan King suddenly dies. The family firm, King's Crystal is in financial uncertainty, including plans to close its factory in Midsomer Magna. Six months later Alan's widow Hilary and his brother Charles are married, much to the chagrin of Alan's son Ian. With family feuds and factory workers angered by the loss of their jobs, there's many motives in the mix. When Peter Baxter, the firm's accountant is found dead, stabbed with a Masonic dagger.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Rocks festival is due to take place and music fans descend on neighbouring fields to enjoy the fiesta. The recently reformed band Hired Gun, are one of the headline acts and during their opening performance, the bands vocalist Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage whilst holding on to her microphone stand, that had an added mystery wire. Barnaby and Jones soon discover other band members could be targets.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When popular GP, Doctor Alan Delaney borrows fellow Dr. James Kirkwood's new car to do an evening call-out. He is mysteriously killed in a hit and run during a drive through woods in a thunderstorm. Barnaby and Jones start investigating in Midsomer Market and discover that James may have been the intended victim. The case leads them to North Walesformer home of Delyth Mostyn, James's fiance to delve further.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the pretty village of Luxton Deeping, there's fierce conflict between the traditional film and modern digital photographers. When their societies committee decide not to accept digital images at the annual photographic exhibition, it appears to make things worse. It leads to a confrontation at the private view. The following day Lionel Bell is found murdered in woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cámara oculta; El colmo de la justicia
programme.desc: Raúl demanda a Elizabeth, quien lo contrató para hacer un video social y fue agredido. Juan Carlos se encontró con el asesino de su hijo, quien fue absuelto del crimen, y le dio una paliza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vendió a su hija; Romeo chamuscado
programme.desc: Yosdel pide la custodia de su hija porque Dayana, la madre de la niña, la vendió clandestinamente. Ángeles no puede tener hijos y para que canalice ese sentimiento su esposo le regala un perro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sin intención de nada; La sapa
programme.desc: Por hacer payasadas en internet obtiene más ingresos que como profesor, su esposa no entiende. La suspendieron por copiarse en un examen y en venganza le roba una foto íntima a quien la delató.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El perro se ha convertido en un peligro porque es muy agresivo y lo usan en peleas callejeras. Tiene una diarrea incontrolable, provocada por las galletas para degustación de una cafetería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El autista destacado; Fuga con consecuencia
programme.desc: La acusan de convertir a su hijo en un señor mayor que viste de traje y corbata, y habla como adulto. Hacen un intercambio profesional, pero a él lo retienen en Cuba cuando ella huye a EE.UU.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un mimo le alegra la vida a Rosa, no quiere separarse de él, pero su esposo no soporta la situación. Hace un video para humillar a su hija cuando le dispara a su laptop y le rompe el teléfono.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Aspirando la regla; Una buena decisión
programme.desc: Teresa deja que Rubí le extraiga su menstruación con una aspiradora para acortar el ciclo, pero no imagina que esa sangre se vende por internet. Incumple un contrato por una buena causa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No fue intencional, fue accidental; La abuela karateca
programme.desc: Se lanza del carro por una rabieta y provoca una tragedia. La condenan a pagar una indemnización por la golpiza que propinó y ella le exige a su pareja que la pague porque le salvó la vida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Me desfiguró el rostro; Drogas en la mascota
programme.desc: Angélica demanda a Linda por daños al salir de su spa con cuatro cejas y quemaduras. Cher acusa a Jonathan de drogar a su mascota, un lémur, que se puso agresiva y le sacó un ojo a la dueña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea quiere que Juan Carlos la indemnice porque fue prostituida durante un viaje en barco. Rossi desea casarse con un vestido lleno de luces, su esposo tiene fotofobia y quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés estaba felizmente casado con Roberto, pero se fue de viaje y regresó transformado en mujer. Eustacio es un octogenario que le alquiló su vivienda a Mildred y ahora quiere recuperarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yennifer renta su vientre, pero tiene orden de deportación, Rey, el padre del bebé quiere que dé a luz antes de irse. El creador del "órgano-piano" desea patentarlo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La realidad de un secuestro; Caza depredadores
programme.desc: María Eugenia quiere que su esposo pague el rescate que piden por su hijo secuestrado. Tina le pide a Ángel 15 mil dólares porque le tomó unas fotografías que usa para cazar depravados.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Emmanuel tiene 18 hijos de diferentes mujeres y distintas nacionalidades, algunas de ellas le exigen que se haga una vasectomía para que pare de traer al mundo niños que no puede mantener.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ilusiones ingenuas; Salió cara la serenata
programme.desc: Quiere que le autoricen su regreso a Cuba, pero la madre prefiere que el sistema se haga cargo de su hija. Un niño da una serenata y le lanzan un objeto que le rompe la cabeza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Obligan a su novia a abortar, ella se suicida. Fabiola participa en unos encuentros que organiza Alejandro, por su culpa termina casi violada y contagiada con hepatitis.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cantante salvadora; Amor a la hormiga brava
programme.desc: La cantante ve lo que parece una agresión a un homosexual y detiene su actuación, el público golpea al supuesto agresor. Su esposo solo se excita si hormigas bravas lo pican en los genitales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Adicción sin control; La próxima víctima
programme.desc: Christian pide que Cecilia le dé una compensación porque se masturbó en su taxi y subió el video a la red. Está asustado porque su esposa es viuda de tres hombres que murieron sospechosamente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Hija de migrantes intenta quitarse de encima ese estigma y elimina su lengua natal, el español. En otro caso, Favo y Tormento son raperos y se enfrentan por la letra de una canción.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Karen, menor de edad, es fanática de los tatuajes, pero sufre serios daños al hacerse uno en el brazo. Melisa le inyecta a su abuelo su propia sangre porque él quiere rejuvenecer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Que se saque los ojos; Estafa embrujada
programme.desc: Camilo exige que su esposa vuelva a casa y lo atienda, cuando quedó ciego, ella lo abandonó. Vanessa pide que invaliden el traspaso de su inmueble porque actuó bajo los efectos de una brujería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ninoska le repara una pieza dental a Mari que antes le había dado problemas, ahora enfrenta una demanda. Le pasan la lengua a los helados y luego los devuelven, para dañarle el negocio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El secreto peligroso; Culpa y capricho
programme.desc: Carolina dice que Patricia oculta un pasado que afecta la relación, ella le reprocha el haberlo destapado. Quiere el divorcio de su esposa porque siente que es un depravado sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Señalan a Juan de participar en el secuestro y muerte de una parte de la familia de Abel. Debby subasta el agua de unos baños que se dio y su amigo Josué le exige la mitad del dinero ganado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Maldad en la sangre; Niña loca por amor
programme.desc: Natalia quiere la custodia de su sobrina abusada por la pareja de su hermana. Rosa, recuperada de su enfermedad, regresa de un viaje y descubre que su hija está enamorada de su padrastro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mi hijo tiene satiriasis; Mujeres histéricas
programme.desc: El hijo de Martha tiene satiriasis, una enfermedad que provoca un desenfrenado deseo sexual. Milagros sufre histeria femenina y solo se calma con los masajes de su yerno, su hija está molesta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su marido muere por un malentendido, exige compensación. En la ceremonia del pañuelo comprueban que la novia no era virgen y se cancela la celebración, lo que provoca una deshonra a la familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Susana le pide una compensación a Alex, quien se interpuso en una discusión de pareja y provocó la muerte de su esposo. Geidy quiere divorciarse de Roberto, y que él y su ex desalojen la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lorena demanda a Claudia por tenderle una trampa que pone en peligro su asilo. Amanda se enamora del hijo de su amante, y tienen un bebé juntos, pero ahora la abuela no reconoce a su nieto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vianey quiere proteger a su hermana, pues su madre permitió que su padrastro la abusara sexualmente. Clara le disputa a César la custodia de sus dos hijos, lo considera una mala influencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema hace que Rutila grabe un video como prueba de vida para Aurelio, ya que quiere hacer negocios. Andrew obtiene material donde el general Garnica aparece con drogas, con el que pretende chantajearlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su escondite de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto y Leonor se enfrentan por última vez. Él descubre la emboscada, pero no puede escapar de su suerte. Moribundo, asegura que ella se ha convertido en lo que tanto combatió, una asesina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Heriberto, Aurelio declara la guerra para vengarlo: tiene ganas de matar a medio mundo. Todos se preparan para lo peor. Victoria le pone más protección a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio envía a Chacorta para ajustar cuentas con Leonor e Ignacio por la muerte de Heriberto: la orden es asesinarlos a todos. Ximena está desconsolada, y culpa a su exesposo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio intenta interrogar al Manotas, pero la rabia se lo impide, y lo mata. Comienza a vengarse de todos los que participaron en la muerte de su padre. Victoria gana las elecciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa insiste en reunirse con el Chema, pero ya no tiene mucho que ofrecerle, y él le envenena la comida. Ernesto confiesa a su nuevo patrón que Aurelio está vivo, y le busca pruebas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila escapa con Ernesto con la esperanza de vivir juntos, y Aurelio se desespera porque sus hombres no logran encontrarla. Chacorta presiona a Víctor para que le dé información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: While shooting pool in a Louisiana bar, Andre Daigle meets a beautiful and mysterious woman. That night he disappears. With no clues to go on, Andre's family calls in psychic Rosemarie Kerr - whose remarkable visions provide answers to a baffling crime. In New Jersey, a teenage girl vanishes while walking home from school. Witnesses saw her walking near a young man whose alibi is shaky. But police have no evidence and must release the suspect - who then vanishes himself. Psychic Nancy Orlen Weber joins the case and offers uncannily accurate descriptions of the crime, the suspect - and where he's hiding.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale, Jeff reflects on his favorite moments shared with chef Mirciny Moliviatis—from vibrant markets to intimate kitchen conversations. Together, they share a heartfelt meal, revisit the colorful streets of Guatemala, and experience life on a small coffee farm near Lake Atitlán, where tradition and sustainability go hand in hand. It's a warm, personal close to a season filled with rich flavors, meaningful encounters, and unforgettable landscapes.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.sub-title: American Travelers: Hawaii The Big Island
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit the big island of Hawaii and see some of the most stunning beaches in the world.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. programme.desc: Diego is a boy with problems. Tartassed at school, he does not find a better climate in his family, harassed as he is by his mother and stepfather who put his younger half-brothers before him. Tired of the situation Diego decides to leave and finds a job at a sports club where he can secretly train in swimming, his great sporting passion. There he also finds a couple of loving friends, older than him, who adopt him almost like a son. However, fate has a bitter sentence in store.

Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "LIKE BUTTON"

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "BARCODE"

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Colorful Conundrums"

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Don't Believe Your Eyes"

El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La Navidad está a la vuelta de la esquina, pero la comida y el correo cruciales de Buffalo se detienen. Una incautación del motor deja a Scott, AJ y el avión C-46, creando una reacción en cadena caótica. El crujiente mecánico Chuck debe intentar un cambio de motor con las manos desnudas en menos 30, y la presión de los clientes y compañeros de trabajo empuja al gerente de carga Kelly.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Trick Or Treat Your Body Healthy
programme.desc: Have no fear this Halloween! The Doctors reveals tricks for treating your health! Dr. Ordon shares spooktacular at-home skin treatments. And, nutritious Halloween candy!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Treat It Now or Pay Later?
programme.desc: Actress Sally Field joins The Doctors to raise awareness about osteoporosis, a bone-thinning disease that affects four times more women than men. Learn steps to take to preserve the health of your bones.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A teenage girl is bullied because of her painful skin condition; will The Doctors be able to save her skin? Then, The Doctors discusses the latest health news. Could binge-watching your favorite shows trigger binge-drinking? Dr. Ordon reveals the latest nip-tuck trends, including a “No Downtime Neckline” procedure to help you say goodbye to your double chin! Plus, find out how you can fight wrinkles in your sleep!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: End chronic snoring, learn when a birthmark is a sign of something more serious and why your child gets sick at school. Plus, why Brussels sprouts may erase wrinkles better than Botox.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: School Field Trip To Gun Range?
programme.desc: Shock and outrage as a group of students, as young as 6 years old, go on a field trip to a gun range! Plus, a new way your antibiotics could put you at risk for superbugs! Then, actress Roselyn Sanchez is joined by her husband and actor Eric Winter to reveal their pregnancy secret. Next, in a THE DOCTORS exclusive, the hero becomes the victim when a lawyer’s life is changed forever by one of the most brutal cases of domestic violence. Plus, could you get a life-threatening infection at the beach?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A family fed up with their mother’s years of alcohol abuse turns to THE DOCTORS for help! Will she finally quit her drinking and accept that she needs to go to rehab? Then, do you believe in past lives? We meet a mom who says her son is the reincarnation of Major League Baseball player Lou Gehrig! Plus, elementary school drop-off lines are stressful, but why would a mom pull a gun on another mom? A woman disfigured by her ex when he threw acid in her face receives a life-changing facial procedure! Don’t miss her transformation!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Horrible accidents and life-threatening conditions can happen to anyone at any time, even you! Learn how to prevent a critical head injury, E.coli poisoning, severe dehydration and more. And, spot the hazards in your home!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Common Medical Risks On The Go
programme.desc: Behind the wheel, in a plane or on a train, learn how to avoid injuries and stay safe while on the go. And, Dr. Travis’ fun and safe workout tips for busy moms.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors present five-minute cures for common ailments. See a procedure that stops nasal allergy symptoms for good. And, cosmetic dentist Dr. Dorfman shares dental Dos and Don'ts, including an instant cure for canker sores.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A woman suspects she has thyroid cancer after an episode of The Doctors. Did she catch it in time? Haylie Duff dishes up family-friendly recipes that are good for you! A woman accuses a sex toy company of spying on her! The latest drug danger facing your teen could be found in the gardening store? Plus, could a vodka protect your liver?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Surprise your Valentine! The Doctors and sex expert Dr. Ruth Westheimer give you tips to have better sex now! Learn why you should never skip foreplay and how an ordinary spoon can heat things up in the bedroom!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Tis The Season to Be Healthy
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: The holidays are here! Get the secrets to staying healthy and trim while celebrating the season. Get delicious recipes, surefire workouts, and fabulous gift ideas for the loved ones on your list!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: 20 Fast Fixes For Loads Of Problems
programme.desc: Learn how maple syrup reduces the risk of cancer, the advantages of vinegar and treat five ailments for one dollar. Plus, if you think vodka is only good for making cosmos, think again! Discover the health benefits behind the bar.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Inside The ER with Dr. Travis Stork
programme.desc: Get an inside look at real-life trauma and drama as The Doctors follows Dr. Travis into the E.R. And, The Triplets, whose baby girls are all approaching their first birthday, are back! Get the answers to their biggest new-mom questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Top 5 Questions To Ask Your Doctor
programme.desc: Learn how to interview potential doctors, which tests you need and how to make the most of your next doctor’s visit. Plus, when you need to go to the emergency room – STAT.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A young man proposes in the ER in his hospital gown and the moment goes completely viral! Now, in a The Doctors exclusive, The couple shares their story, from what nearly took his life to the moment she said yes … and they’re in for a big surprise! A runner fights off a brutal attack with self-defense! Hear her remarkable story and safety tips for you! A woman endures years of teasing for her tiny teeth; can they be fixed? Then, what if your drinking water was hot pink? Would you drink it? One town recently dealt with this issue! A new study confirms how much urine is in the average pool! What you need to know before your next swim! The guide to being a “fab mom”! Plus, the fridge mistakes spoiling your food fast!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: Snowfall, family fun and holiday cheer make winter the most wonderful time of the year. Learn how to winterize your home, keep your little ones warm and protect your skin from the elements!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors field 100 questions in one hour! Can sex make you healthier? Do infants have acid reflux? What’s the best way to prepare for the upcoming flu season? Don’t miss the answer to these and 97 other questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors investigates Hollywood’s Adderall epidemic. Former Hollywood “It-girl” says Adderall destroyed her life. What’s behind the increase in adult ADHD and is it a valid diagnosis? Safer alternatives for stimulant drugs. A procedure that gives a keyhole pout.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Whether it’s puberty, menopause or old age, learn how to stay healthy at every age. Plus, get the ultimate guide to treating adolescent acne, and learn how to help your baby take his or first steps!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, a young man falls 2,000+ feet and survives days in a blizzard…how did he do it? Are you paying different prices for the exact same medication? Why are more and more women turning to physical therapy for their private parts? Could loneliness be as deadly as cigarettes? Then, a husband and wife turn back the clock with facelifts … and reveal their new looks on set! We test magnetic eyelashes and tell you if they work! Plus, see what happens when bullfighting goes wrong … very wrong!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, meet the father who had to have his hands and feet amputated after an extremely rare case of strep throat! Don’t miss the moment his family gets the surprise of a lifetime! Then, reality TV star and model Courtney Stodden reaches out to THE DOCTORS for help with depression and drugs and speaks out about her controversial marriage and rocky relationship with her mother! Plus, a doctor’s fight to save his brother’s life requires he become a donor! Then, a guest who was addicted to eating clay pots returns; has she kicked her strange habit for good?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you your own worst critic? From sweaty armpits to thick ankles, see new solutions for your most “embarrassing” body problems. And, get simple, at-home remedies for brittle nails.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Why Do I Itch and Smell Like That?
programme.desc: Get the lowdown on bug, mosquito and spider bites, tickles in the back of your throat and more! And, why bad breath may indicate a more serious problem. Plus, see the latest at-home technology to relieve itchy skin.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Maureen McCormick reveals new details of her shocking past! Then, one woman undergoes a live procedure for her resting “angry” face, did it work? Plus, what you need to know to protect your child from the super lice outbreak and a child abductor!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Caught on tape: a public meltdown at the gym! What to do when someone flies off the handle in public! Then, a 90-pound weight loss without surgery? Hear one woman’s personal tips that helped her get trim! And, The voice of beloved cartoon characters like Bugs Bunny, Ren and Stimpy, Doug and Futurama reveals his story of overcoming prostate cancer! The risk factors all men need to know! Plus, legendary Latin King of Comedy Paul Rodriguez opens up about his sister’s tragic diabetic death. Hear his heartache and his desire to improve his own personal health. Then, if you’re one of the 42 million Americans struggling with constipation, proctologist Dr. David Rosenfeld shares his top foods that can help you poop! Plus, a sweet trick for a bug-free BBQ!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Marriage, work, motherhood and stress can take a toll on your health, as well as your looks. Actress and author Lisa Rinna joins The Doctors to lend insight on how to get your sexy back, and look and feel your best at any age!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Dr. G: Medical Examiner says that the dead don’t keep secrets. Watch a simulated autopsy, and learn ways to keep premature death and disease from your doorstep. And, a procedure that can shrink you six sizes in less than six hours.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Runny noses, stuffy heads and aching bodies can only mean one thing: cold and flu season is in full swing. Find out 40 ways to fight the flu and outsmart a cold! Plus, the latest technology to keep your gadgets germ-free.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Go inside the operating room with Dr. Ordon as he removes 10 pounds of sagging skin from a woman. And, find out why dead people want plastic surgery.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Whether it’s a tick, a cyst, phlegm or dirt, or if you’ve got something stuck in your eye or ear, get tips to get it out! Plus, are you ready to give birth? Get the safest ways to speed up labor and delivery.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals the health secrets behind your bodily fluids. Find out how to keep acne breakouts at bay and how to stop excessive perspiration!

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You

programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.sub-title: How To See South America By Bus

programme.sub-title: Eb Discovers The Birds And The Bees

programme.sub-title: A Home Isn't Built In A Day
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world…and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!
